versions.changelog:
Initial release of google-agents-cli-claw.

- Provides an entrypoint for the Google agents-cli toolchain (Agent Development Kit).
- Installs agents-cli and 7 specialized skills for scaffolding, building, evaluating, deploying, publishing, and observing agents.
- Enables automatic skill activation based on user requests for common agent development tasks.
- Includes onboarding instructions and setup guidance for new users.
